events.title: Empowerment Yoga
events.description: Start your Sunday with a community yoga flow and good vibes to boost your energy and calm your mind. Every Sunday at Emancipation Park, alone or with the family. Each session takes in breathwork, yoga flow, sound meditation, and time to be among people.
events.arrival_notes: Meet at Pavilion C, by the softball field.

events.title: Candle Lit Couples Stretch Class - Utilizing Yogic Postures and Language
events.description: Connect with your partner through a guided candlelit stretch and yoga flow built around trust and flexibility, then write an intentional letter to your partner, with optional prompts. Partner poses, all levels welcome, light refreshments. Bring a yoga mat and water.

events.title: Empowerment Yoga on the Beach
events.description: Guided breathwork, an Empowerment Yoga flow and a sound-bowl meditation on the beach, then fellowship. All levels, including people who have never done yoga. Bring a mat. Preregistration recommended.

events.title: Roll it up incense making workshop
events.venue: Hue Darling Candle Co, Missouri City
events.description: Roll your own incense with guidance on choosing ingredients for the energy you want in your space: ten incense sticks and a palo santo resin stick to take home, plus how to make your own. Write a letter to yourself and seal it with a wax stamp. A glass of champagne or a mimosa is included, with non-alcoholic options. Arrive early; it starts promptly.
